evidence.reason: drain_queue accepts a drained poll before checking the deadline, and sleeps the full drain_interval rather than capping it to the remaining deadline. With --drain-deadline-s 10 --drain-interval-s 600, a queue that settles after expiry can return drained=true on the next poll and the deploy proceeds despite the expired deadline. This is an implementation error in existing drain behavior, not a new requirement; enforce the deadline after polling/before accepting drained (while preserving an immediate first drained result) and cap sleeps to the remaining time.
